description: A shortcut recorder temporarily releases only owned OS global registrations, accepts an existing combination, and restores them before completion. Stale leases/events never affect a replacement recorder.

nativeExceptions.macos: The shortcut recorder uses a separate nonactivating NSPanel. AppKit controls which native window and first responder becomes key after closing; the app does not force focus back to an initiating Settings button.
nativeExceptions.windows: The shortcut recorder is an in-page modal and restores focus to the current Settings Record button resolved by its stable ID after the renderer replaces old DOM nodes.
nativeExceptions.reason: Separate native window versus re-rendered DOM control. On macOS, focus can return to the containing native window rather than precisely the initiating Settings button. Both platforms close the recorder and release global shortcuts.
